purpose: Distinguish deterministic coordinate phase, mixed geometric measurement, coarse-to-pixel support leakage and surface versus virtual transport without changing the anchor estimator.
execution_prerequisites: Job08 reviews adapter/PRODUCTION_ADAPTER.md and supplies the real original-guide support-builder implementation; diagnostic externally supplied certificates do not establish production support.
Compile fresh baseline and candidate shaders with compiler/source/include hashes. Do not substitute bundled historical CSO bytes for a newly changed root signature.
Retain default-off settings and user working preset; run a local isolated test harness before any optional in-game A/B.
Respect native private corrected D/S to RR/NZR versus original G3 routing; no DLL installation is requested by this package.

route_labels.label: native_actual_anchor_route
route_labels.proof: Capture actual private pair at provider boundary and native output resource identities; mock-provider and extracted combined-host runs must be labelled separately.

route_labels.label: combined_anchor_route

route_labels.proof: Report its signed key-depth store separately. A combined pass result is not evidence of native routing.

compiler.unknown_flags_policy: Record any driver/host build or additional DXC flags; do not assume their values or claim byte parity across compiler versions.

candidate_binding_contract.constants: ActiveExtent, GridExtent, Cell, geometric tolerances, enabled flag and reserved padding; exact packed ABI from adapter/SupportCertifiedApply.hlsl must be reflected and checked before binding.
candidate_binding_contract.host_descriptor_change: Current native heap has18 entries. Candidate Apply alone needs5 SRV+3 UAV=8 versus baseline1+2=3, so at least23 entries before any certificate-building pass. Charge all extra resources and descriptors.
candidate_binding_contract.support_builder_status: Required integration work; precomputed exact-support or CPU certificates are diagnostic inputs, not production shader outputs.
candidate_binding_contract.geometry_precision_limit: Coplanar unknown object/material identity is unidentifiable from plane/normal guides alone. Parallel surfaces separated by less than the configured relative plane tolerance (proposed1e-4 times depthscale) may share a certificate. Report these as ambiguity failures versus oracle truth, not a guaranteed boundary-safety class.

experiments.guide_allocation_cases: For each active extent, test equal allocation and a larger allocation (192x160 for137x131;128x96 for67x53;32x16 for15x9), with poison values outside active support. Native D/S remain exact active extent by host contract.

crop_cases.rule: Treat unavailable surroundings as unknown; preserve render-space projection and motion scale.

matrix_convention.memory: JSON list[row][column]; transpose only at shared Desc adapter

jitter.canonical_mv: previous_raster-current_raster divided by original_render_extent; includes jitter delta exactly once

experiments.scene: Constant z=+/-4 and+/-8 planes; analytic sloped plane; intersecting planes; moving foreground rectangle at depth2 against wall8. In RH use negative view Z and positive stored native key depth.
experiments.ring: Six physical slices and host priority order exported. All unused/moving cells explicitly zeroed. Capture pre-gain level; native key depth abs(Stats.y), combined signed behaviour separately recorded.
experiments.acceptance: Correct analytic model preserves declared round-trip and occlusion ordering; each wrong control must violate its targeted invariant. Frozen source half-pixel result is recorded as baseline behaviour, not silently relabelled correct.

experiments.thin_features: 1-pixel-wide foreground strips at all phases; horizontal and vertical. Also diagonal crossing of two planes.

gain_controls.exact_support: Frozen analytic same-surface/observed mask; never derived from candidate output
gain_controls.real_certificate: Independent all-pixel depth/normal/static certificate over complete gain-estimator footprint; report separately

unchanged coarse estimator plus declared complete donor support

centre_cell_not_pixel_witness.meaning: Stored right-cell gain1 does not prevent a0.0875 correction at a protected pixel.

dump: four source taps and weights if available
sampler_witness.policy: Compare exact decisions using actual sampled values; separately quantify continuous-NumPy versus hardware fraction differences. No blanket tolerance for wrong support decisions.

rules: Never loop sequence or reset published capture frame IDs to manufacture warmup.
Record scheduled, submitted, completed fence and semantic-valid state separately.
Preserve old graph leases through completion; reject new-generation reuse of discarded ring data.
Test current crop origin changes with no physical motion, and physical motion with fixed crop independently.
d3d_debug_requirements: debug layer and GPU-based validation enabled for correctness run
separate timing-only run with debug disabled; never hide correctness errors in timing mode

experiments.current_previous_transforms: Reuse experimentA identity/translation/rotation matrix pairs with declared jitter.
experiments.scene: Static planar mirror and static virtual reflected point. Compute reflection geometry analytically; surface depth2, valid reflection distance6 in common world units. Include zero/NaN/missing hit, foreground occluder, mixed two-reflector coverage and object movement.
experiments.hit_distance_role: Usable reflection-ray distance observation for this analytic case. Captured native alpha must have its actual role attested before applying the same model.
experiments.acceptance: Virtual-point correspondence must match analytic feature location under translation and not manufacture validity from matching hit alone. History reset smoothing is reported as lost detail, not a transport improvement.

experiments.history_start: Replay original preceding local sequence from genuine reset if available; otherwise preserve actual warmed native ring snapshot and label startup unobservable. Do not synthesize prior keys from partial fixture.
input_stages: private Anchor output at provider boundary
experiments.pairing: Fresh baseline/candidate with same native route, provider binary, frame order, crop, exposure, camera and settings. Keep estimator identical for reconstruction isolation; coordinate changes separate A/B.
experiments.output_scope: 192x192 fixed core for output comparisons;320x320 original-guide patch for support; six full coarse key slices for recall. No whole-game capture requested.
visual_failure_criteria: any protected moving/disoccluded region receives unsupported correction
loss of1-pixel or facade detail after correction-dose and level matching
native original G3 inputs change, or legal native hit-distance alpha fails measured raw16-bit equality
experiments.game_claim_gate: Actual fresh AMD RR output and user local final-game observation required. Mock provider/pass-only tests are reported in separate evidence classes.

tolerances.round_trip_rationale: Small test extents and well-conditioned camera matrices; report worst error and condition numbers; do not apply to uncontrolled kilometre-world transforms without measured bound.
tolerances.rgba16f_output_parity: At most1 half ULP for equal operation/order and actual sampled inputs; investigate larger differences. Candidate OFF/unsupported returns without writes and requires exact fullRGBA bytes. Active legal finite nonnegative hit-distance alpha requires measured raw16-bit equality; arbitrary NaN payloads are separate unsupported diagnostics.
tolerances.categorical_support: Zero false-valid/occlusion leakage in exact-support analytic cases. Actual sample-derived decisions must match exactly; continuous sampler discrepancy reported separately.
tolerances.performance_reason: No measured GPU budget or observed performance exists for this proposal; report incremental pass time and complete native graph time separately.

record: resident allocation and retained old-generation peak bytes
timings_and_memory.scope: Separate support building, Apply, stats/gain, copies, RR provider, NZR and any final composition. CPU time is not GPU time.

payload_policy.phase_sweep: Return complete scalar metric table and hashes; full arrays only for centre-cell witness and worst4 unique phase/orientation failures plus passing control. Do not upload every identical texture.
payload_policy.hashes: SHA256 per original tensor, controls, camera words, shader/input/output; exclude manifest self-hash. Preserve dtype, endianness, shape, row stride, active/allocation extents and source stage.

alpha_test_contract.native_legal_domain: Finite nonnegative hit-distance alpha as actually supplied by native route; preserve original half words and require measured raw16-bit equality for active corrected pixels.
alpha_test_contract.off_and_unsupported: Candidate returns without UAV writes; require exact fullRGBA bytes, not merely equivalent floating-point values.
adversarial_diagnostics: quiet and signalling NaN bit patterns
alpha_test_contract.adversarial_claim_limit: Record typed-load/store bit behaviour separately. Unsupported NaNs cannot certify legal native parity or an arbitrary16-bit payload guarantee.
alpha_test_contract.baseline_pairing: Use identical input words for baseline and candidate and report any canonicalization already present in the baseline.
